Omega (Japanese: オメガ Omega) is one of the two main characters and older brother of in the Pokémon Omega Ruby Crimson Passion and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire Indigo Wisdom manga.

==Pokémon==
 

==Trivia==
Despite Omega being after Alpha in the Greek alphabet, Omega is the older of the two brothers.
